summary: ChatTasks: the plan the agent works to, written, ticked off and revised in place. A chat-widget card with a disclosure header; proposed plans show numbered rows with Run / Change it and a per-row drop; running, complete and stopped plans show six row statuses (done, current, pending, needsYou, failed, skipped) and fold to a header whose glyph is the plan's status. The current task holds StatusMatrix Working's key frame — the plan never moves.
